page.overview:
Who is Adelia Pruitt?

was a human primal origin sorcerer played by Laura Bailey in Age of Umbra.

Adelia was a very small girl with pale white skin and hair. When the party encountered her, she was wearing a nice but slightly tattered dress. After touching the Scepter of Elias for the first time, one of her arms turned completely black, absorbing the darkness that covered the item.

She was a very imaginative child. Adelia didn't like to kill people, but she'd done it "a couple times" when she was really threatened.

Adelia used to live in Amber Reach with her family, a noble house of the Cinnabar Quarter that had spent generations isolated from the world. At some point in the past few years, her father went off with "a silly elf man", and she believes he's still alive. She didn't see what happened to her mother, aunt, and siblings, but she "didn't think it was going to be nice," so she hid, and was left on her own; the men who killed most of her family offered for her to go with them, but she refused since they were dirty and rude..}} The last she knew of her family was that they were with Yuri of the Emerald Crown, one of the Damask Queens.
